brief: One line, at most 160 characters, roasting the smart fridge (or any smart home gadget). Judge (z-ai/glm-5.3-flash) weighs: 1) roasts a smart home gadget, 2) funny with a turn/sting at the end, 3) fresh angle never met before, 4) one line, fast setup, no padding, no second sentence, 5) specific to a real behaviour of the gadget. Stock joke that loses: fridge orders too much milk.

candidates.angle: Knock-to-see-inside (InstaView) door: the fridge makes its owner knock like a visitor in his own kitchen. Single sentence, sting at the end.
candidates.cluster_avoided: door-alarm beeping, milk reordering, Wi-Fi, touchscreen fingerprints, expiry nagging, recipe suggestions, camera surveillance, smarter-than-owner
candidates.text: My smart fridge makes me knock twice to see what's inside, like I'm visiting my own leftovers.

candidates.angle: Water-filter countdown holding the water dispenser hostage until a $50 filter is bought. Single sentence, 'protection racket' sting at the end.
candidates.cluster_avoided: door-alarm beeping, milk reordering, Wi-Fi, touchscreen fingerprints, expiry nagging, recipe suggestions, camera surveillance, smarter-than-owner
candidates.text: My fridge cut off my water until I bought its fifty-dollar filter, so my own kitchen runs a protection racket.

candidates.angle: Showroom/demo mode: the fridge stops cooling but keeps glowing. Single sentence, 'while my guests starved' sting at the end.
candidates.cluster_avoided: door-alarm beeping, milk reordering, Wi-Fi, touchscreen fingerprints, expiry nagging, recipe suggestions, camera surveillance, smarter-than-owner
candidates.text: My fridge slipped into demo mode at a dinner party and just stood there glowing while my guests starved.
